name: AITrendIndicator
description: Renders a directional arrow + signed delta + a secondary "vs Close" label. Caller passes a pre-formatted delta string (`+8.4%`, `-3.1%`, `0.0%`, `+4`) so the atom stays unit-agnostic. Inline SVG arrow keeps the atom font-independent — works on surfaces that have not loaded the Guild icon font.
intent: How is this metric trending? One row, three tones — green up, red down, gray flat. Pairs with `ai-metric-value` inside every metric card.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: label
props.hint: Secondary sub-label rendered after the delta.
